Claim: session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w` (PM seat `domain:spec`, dispatching `os-dev`) · branch `claude/issue-9042-changeset-false-sentences`
Clause-②: no

Prose in two pending changesets. No accept set moves, no exported symbol changes, no key is added or removed. ⛔ Provisional; your diff decides — and ⚠️ a `no` puts `check-widening-tells.mjs` live, so if your diff touches anything but markdown, the declaration is wrong and you must say so rather than proceeding.

## Why this is dispatched now and not later

`.changeset/*.md` is **release-note input**, consumed at publish. Both sentences are wrong **today**, on `main`, and ship as written at the next `@object-ui/types` release. After that publish the correction belongs in a docs-only PR against `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md` — ⛔ never as a rider on a code PR (the release-notes guardrail). So the window is now.

## ⛔ Site 1 is a ONE-WORD fix and a naive find-and-replace breaks it

`.changeset/8992-user-actions-collapse-and-docblock.md` contains **two** occurrences of "ten" and only one is wrong. `UserActionsConfigSchema` has **eleven** members; `buttons` is the only one that never carried a default, so **ten** are defaulted, and PR #9017 moved **three** of those ten.

| occurrence | verdict |
|---|---|
| "Measured on this object: **all ten** defaulted keys read `description = undefined` after the strip" | ✅ **CORRECT — ⛔ do not touch** |
| "before, the local extension supplied descriptions **the other ten** defaulted keys did not have" | ❌ **WRONG — the three are among the ten; "the other" ones are seven** |

The file's own item 2 already says "SEVEN of the other eight keys have declared ZodDefault all along" and enumerates them, so it contradicts itself and the seven is the half that is right. **Re-derive the member count and the defaulted count yourself by content** before changing a digit — ⛔ do not take this table on trust.

## ⚠️ Site 2 is a PARAGRAPH, not a clause, and the obvious fix is the wrong one

`.changeset/8913-object-kanban-columns-declared.md` lines ~65-69. Three claims fell when PR #9021 landed (`a4b723fab99b5e74917e03598382d25d15f487da`):

| claim | status |
|---|---|
| "`groupBy` is **required** on this face" | **FALSE** — `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:3033` is `groupBy?: string;` and `zod/objectql.zod.ts:1286` is `z.string().optional()` |
| "is **inert** on this block … no document that passes this schema reaches it" | **FALSE** — a schema-valid lane-less board now reaches the bare-string arm |
| "the requiredness is tracked as objectui#8990" | stale — #8990 is `closed` / `completed` |

⛔ **Do not fix this by deleting the trailing `objectui#8990` clause.** The **headline sentence** is the wrong one. Rewrite the paragraph to say the arm is now reachable, and cite #8990 as the change that made it so rather than as pending work. Re-derive all three readings by content on current `main` — anchors drift.

## ⛔ What you owe

1. **Verify both files are still PENDING**, i.e. still in `.changeset/` on `main` **and** their text absent from `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md`, each with a live control (I measured 0 occurrences against a 4550-line CHANGELOG — reproduce it, don't cite it). If either has already been released, ⛔ stop and report: the fix moves to the CHANGELOG and is a different PR.
2. **Does this PR need a changeset of its own?** Read `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` by content and say what it answers for a markdown-only diff under `.changeset/`, rather than guessing either way.
3. **Sweep for siblings.** Two pending changesets carry now-false sentences; ⚠️ check whether others do — particularly any that reference a card closed today (#8990, #8992, #9012, #8604). Report what you find; ⛔ do not widen this PR to fix them unless each is the same one-line class, and say explicitly which you fixed and which you only reported.
4. ⚠️ **The PR body of objectui#9017** carries the same "the other ten" sentence. Correcting a merged PR's body is optional and cosmetic — report whether you did it and why, ⛔ do not treat it as required.

⚠️ **Zone-2: re-derive every number above on your own base, including this seat's.** I got a premise wrong on another card today — I reported a restart condition "MET" from a symbol grep when its real condition was a behavioural probe, and the probe came back the opposite. **Finding one wrong is worth more than compliance.**

## File surface — ⛔ stay out

- `packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts`, `packages/components/src/renderers/form/input.tsx`, and `.changeset/8762-*` — PR #9051, open
- `packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts`, `packages/types/package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` — a dev is on #8563 now
- `packages/types/src/views.ts`, `packages/plugin-tree/**`, `packages/plugin-view/**` — a dev is on #8841 now

Your surface is `.changeset/8992-user-actions-collapse-and-docblock.md` and `.changeset/8913-object-kanban-columns-declared.md`. ⛔ Nothing else without reporting first.

## Standing rules

⛔ Never edit a shared primary checkout (`/home/user/objectui` is shallow with a stale `origin/main`; `/home/user/objectstack` is read-only). Clone fresh; report both HEADs and clean state at start and finish.
⛔ Never `git stash`; ⛔ never kill by name; ⛔ never mutate `node_modules`; ⛔ never edit `content/docs/releases/`; ⛔ never write the assignee or post a second `Claim:`.
⚠️ ⛔ **Never print an unconditional "no hits = clean" line.** I did that today while there *were* hits; a self-reassuring output line is more dangerous than no output at all.
Capture every `rc` to a file **before** any pipe. Read lint counts from `--format json`, ⚠️ not grepped text.
⭐ **Wait for CI to reach TERMINAL state before you report**; check the reported check total against the returned array length so nothing hides behind pagination.
⭐ **Read the stored body back after every GitHub write.** Use REST. ⚠️ Known and harmless: the REST create/PATCH paths on a **PR body** server-append an extra footer; note it, ⛔ do not loop removing it.
⭐ **Hang `needs:contract-review` on your PR when you open it** — it is a DUAL-carrier gate (`check-half-states.mjs` H31) and the card already carries it, so a bare PR manufactures the exact half-state that check exists to catch. This supersedes the blanket "don't touch labels" line in earlier briefs; that wording was mine and it was wrong, and two devs have now had to surface the conflict.
⛔ **PR stays `draft`** — landing is the seat's act. GitHub content in **English**.

## ⛔ Correction to the `Claim:` comment above, before the dev acts on it

The standing-rules block I just posted ends with:

> ⭐ Hang `needs:contract-review` on your PR when you open it — it is a DUAL-carrier gate … **and the card already carries it**, so a bare PR manufactures the exact half-state that check exists to catch.

**That clause is false on THIS card**, and following it would produce the inverse defect. It is boilerplate I wrote for the `Clause-②: yes` cards dispatched earlier tonight, and I carried it here without re-checking the premise.

Measured just now: this card's labels are `documentation`, `domain:spec`, `finding`, `package: types`, `pm:dispatched`, `priority:p2` — **no `needs:contract-review`**, which is correct, because the declaration on this card is `Clause-②: no`.

⇒ **⛔ Do NOT hang `needs:contract-review` on the PR for this card.** The dual-carrier rule says the two carriers must AGREE; here they agree at *absent*. Hanging it on the PR alone would manufacture the half-state in the other direction — precisely the failure the rule exists to prevent.

⚠️ The rest of that standing-rules block stands, including the part the correction is attached to: the blanket "don't touch labels" wording in my earlier briefs **was** wrong for `Clause-②: yes` cards, and two devs had to surface that conflict tonight. The fix is not "always hang it" — it is **make the PR carrier match the card carrier**, whichever state that is, and say so if you cannot tell.

If your diff turns out to move an accept set after all, then the declaration is wrong, ⛔ and the remedy is to **report it and stop**, not to hang the label and proceed.

## Release: MERGED — objectui#9042 / PR objectui#9064

Both now-false sentences are corrected in the pending changesets on `main`, before the next `@object-ui/types` release consumes them.

**Landing commit `a7a8183838b8fb73926aa32896cd3d1db98f4c2d`** · merged 2026-09-10T22:06:13Z · squash, parent `7f27bc5434`. It is the **parent** of objectui#9060's landing — the queue took both in one batch.

### Two readings, ⛔ never a single API field

1. **Timeline** — `added_to_merge_queue` 21:39:57Z → `merged` 22:06:13Z → `closed` / `removed_from_merge_queue` 22:06:13Z.
2. **`origin/main` by content** —

```
git merge-base --is-ancestor a7a8183838b8fb73926aa32896cd3d1db98f4c2d origin/main   rc=0
git merge-base --is-ancestor e70158bc7ac340852f2b04f97f0516cf2e9eff01 origin/main   rc=1   <- the control, and it FIRES
```

### Behaviour verification — and the control here is the occurrence that must NOT have moved

| reading on `main` | value |
|---|---|
| `8992-…md` — `the other seven defaulted keys` | **1** |
| `8992-…md` — `the other ten defaulted keys` | **0** |
| **CONTROL** — `all ten defaulted keys` (the CORRECT occurrence) | **1**, survived |
| `8913-…md` — `groupBy` is required | **0** |
| `8913-…md` — the rewritten reachability paragraph | present |
| **CONTROL** — `bare-string array` still discussed in `8913-…md` | **1**, so the paragraph was rewritten and not deleted |

That third row is the whole point of the card: the file held two whole-word `ten`s, one right and one wrong, and a find-and-replace would have destroyed the right one.

### What this landing was, and was not

It is the first PR this session to land on a **`Clause-②: no`** declaration — no in-seat contract review owed, both carriers correctly **absent** rather than present, and `--pair` agreeing at absent. ⛔ Not a skipped gate.

⚠️ And its widening-tells gate **told me its own rc 0 was uninformative**: *"⛔ NOT MEASURED is not a clean reading — no tell could have fired on these files whatever they contain."* `.changeset/*.md` is not a declared surface. What the `no` actually rested on was the diff being markdown-only under `.changeset/`, confirmed on the diff by inspection.

### Three corrections this card produced, all to my own dispatch boilerplate

1. **`check-widening-tells.mjs` does not exist in objectui** — it is objectstack's, wired into objectstack's `lint.yml`. Real for this seat's landing decision; ⛔ never a red a dev here can wait for.
2. **`h31ContractReviewCarrierSplit` fires only when the two carriers DISAGREE**, returning null when both are absent — established by reading the script, and it confirms the correction I posted on this card before the dev started.
3. ⭐ **A line-based grep for the target sentence returned a false 0** before the edit, because the phrase spans a line break — it read exactly like "the clause is already gone". What proved presence was a multi-line anchor with a count assertion. The reassuring-output hazard, caught by the person it would have fooled.

### Owed next

Card objectui#9065 now carries **seven** sites: six stale `tracked as #N` citations (weak class) and, added tonight from PR objectui#9052's review, `.changeset/8253-export-tree-view-config.md` — which says *"`titleField` is declared, not deleted"* and *"deleting the read would have reddened its pin"*, the first falsified by objectui#9052 and the second **false when written**. That one is the strong class and should be taken first.

Card closed by the PR's keyword; `pm:dispatched` stripped in this same act.
